@Image 1 定义女主角的身份：深色短波浪卷发、四肢修长纤细的身材，以及造型：超大号驼色 V 领 T 恤、蓬松的驼色灯笼裤（带罗纹收口）、米白色运动鞋。将所有面板视为同一个人。不要使用其白色背景、面板布局或无头裁切。@Image 2 定义世界观与视觉风格：柔和绘画风格化的三维插画，高耸的积云、蓝天、漂浮堆叠的贫民窟塔楼并悬挂着缆线。不要将其静态姿势或取景用作首帧。始终保持这种绘画风格化的媒介。禁止写实皮肤。在允许自然表情变化、呼吸和头部活动的同时，保留面部特征与身材比例。设定：在两座漂浮塔楼之间、远高于云层的高空中，一根极细的线横跨其间。她似乎是唯一的人。那条线几乎不可见，因此她仿佛站立在空气之上。[0–3 秒] 广角建立镜头，摄影机从云层下缓缓升起。她在线的中段站立，双臂张开保持平衡，裤腿在风中摇摆。神情平静，目光专注望向远方。[3–6 秒] 侧面跟拍推车随她移动。她快速迈出三步，双手撑在线上，完成一个前软翻：双腿扫过，一只脚先落地，随后另一只脚落地，重心在线上恢复。在弧顶短暂变速为慢动作，然后恢复正常速度。[6–9 秒] 自上而下的鸟瞰视角，直直越过她的身体俯瞰远下方的云层。她发起一个脱手前空翻；灯笼裤在她双腿周围鼓胀张开。落地时她的身体晃动；一次短促的推拉变焦将下方的深渊拉伸，产生眩晕感。[9–12 秒] 极特写：她的运动鞋压在线上，略微形变。沿线条重新对焦：阳光短暂照亮，一条蛛丝般的闪光沿线滑过，然后消失，线再次隐形。她的手臂矫正平衡；她呼出一口气，稳住自己。[12–16 秒] 荷兰角 FPV 环绕镜头围绕她完整旋转 360°。她单脚完成一个受控的皮鲁埃特旋转，接入一个阿拉伯式伸展动作，双臂伸展，漂浮的塔楼在她身后滑过。她的表情从紧张转为自信的淡淡微笑。[16–20 秒] 极低角度的虫眼视角。她完成最后一个前团身翻，双脚干净地落在线上，膝盖缓冲，双臂大开。摄影机拉远并升起为广角镜头；她保持最终姿态，下巴抬起，望向远处的云。[9–12 秒] 物理：每一次跳跃都展现蹬离、手或脚与线的接触、以及平衡恢复。线在她重量下略微下沉并回弹。头发与衣物跟随她的动作和风。危险通过晃动和下方深渊来感受，但她永不坠落。[12–16 秒] 音频：高空的风声，衣物拍打 <whoosh>，落地时线轻微的 <creak>，闪光时一丝微弱的 <ting>。无音乐、无对白、无字幕、无文字。

Premium Editorial Poster Instructions

Each uploaded photo must be made into a separate, independent, premium editorial poster, and multiple photos must not be combined. Use a strict 3:4 vertical canvas. Split the canvas horizontally in the exact center: the upper half and the lower half each occupy 50% of the height, are equally wide, and equally high, with no alteration of proportion.

The upper half uses the original photo directly and must not be regenerated. Preserve the identity of the main subject, the human body or architectural structure, proportions, perspective, spatial relationships, texture, natural light and shadow, color, and environment in their entirety. Only slight cropping and restrained premium color grading are permitted; re-drawing the main subject, fictional light, HDR, excessive saturation, plastic texture, and fictional content are prohibited. hibited. When needing to adapt to the frame, only environmental areas such as sky, water surface, ground, walls, plants, or background can be extended.

The lower half extracts and reconstructs the "narrative core" of the photo: it can be a single primary subject, or a group of related elements that together embody the photo's identity, scale, action, o story relationship. Maintain its realistic, recognizable appearance, proportion, internal structure, texture, and relative position. Do not remove important related elements, and do not directly us rectangular photo cutouts. The reconstructed subject typically occupies 55%-80% of the width of the lower area. It should naturally extend based on the photo's primary direction and retain plausible ground, water lines, shadows, or softly dissipated edges to integrate into the background, avoiding a sticker-like or floating appearance.

Incorporate a narrow, low-saturation geometric color field behind or through the center of the subject, serving as a "critical window" between reality and editorial abstraction. The color of the window must be extracted from the original photo, and its orientation (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal) chosen based on the overall narrative direction.

The subject must actively pass through the window: part of it is within the color field, and part enters the open negative space, naturally crossing the window's boundary to create occlusion, penetration, and spatial depth. The window is not a frame or a card; it must not fully enclose the subject. Only one primary window is allowed; multiple color blocks, thick borders, rounded corners, strong gradients, and drop shadows are prohibited.

Use a white, cool white, very light gray, or near-white background for the lower half, coordinated with the photo. Employ a restrained asymmetrical composition and abundant negative space to establish a three-tier hierarchy:

Reconstructed subject or narrative composition

Low-saturation geometric window

高级编辑海报制作指令

每张上传的照片必须制作成一张独立的、高级的编辑海报，所有图片不得合并。使用严格的 3:4 纵向画布。在正中央水平分割画布：上半部分和下半部分各占画布高度的 50%，宽度相同，高度相同，不得改变比例。

上半部分直接使用原始照片，不得重新生成。需完整保留主体的身份特征、人体或建筑结构、比例、透视、空间关系、纹理、自然光影、色彩以及环境。仅允许轻微裁剪和克制的高级调色；禁止重绘主体、虚构光线、HDR、过度饱和、塑料质感以及虚构内容。上方一张。需要在画面中进行适配时，仅可延伸天空、水面、地面、墙体、植物或背景等环境区域。

下半部分提取并重构照片的"叙事核心"：可以是一个主要主体，也可以是一组相关的元素，它们共同体现照片的身份、规模、动作或故事情节关系。需保持其真实、可辨识的外观、比例、内部结构、纹理以及相对位置。不得移除重要的相关元素，也不得直接使用矩形照片剪贴。重构主体一般占下半部分宽度的 55%–80%。它应根据照片的主要方向自然延伸，并保留合理的地面、水线、阴影或柔和消散的边缘，以融入背景，避免出现贴纸般或悬浮的外观。

在主体的中心后方或穿过主体中心处，嵌入一个窄幅、低饱和度的几何色块，作为现实与编辑抽象之间的"关键窗口"。窗口的颜色必须从原始照片中提取，其取向（水平、垂直或对角）应根据整体叙事方向进行选择。

主体必须主动穿过该窗口：其一部分位于色块内部，另一部分进入开放的负空间，自然跨越窗口边界，以形成遮挡、穿透和空间纵深。窗口不是画框，也不是卡片，不得完全包裹主体。仅允许出现一个主窗口；禁止使用多个色块、粗边框、圆角、强渐变以及投影效果。

下半部分采用白色、冷白色、极浅灰色或近白色背景，与照片协调。使用克制的非对称构图和大量负空间，以建立三层层次结构：

重构主体或叙事构图

低饱和度的几何窗口

Premium Editorial Poster Instructions

Each uploaded photo must be made into a separate, independent, premium editorial poster, and multiple photos must not be combined. Use a strict 3:4 vertical canvas. Split the canvas horizontally in the exact center: the upper half and the lower half each occupy 50% of the height, are equally wide, and equally high, with no alteration of proportion.

The upper half uses the original photo directly and must not be regenerated. Preserve the identity of the main subject, the human body or architectural structure, proportions, perspective, spatial relationships, texture, natural light and shadow, color, and environment in their entirety. Only slight cropping and restrained premium color grading are permitted; re-drawing the main subject, fictional light, HDR, excessive saturation, plastic texture, and fictional content are prohibited. hibited. When needing to adapt to the frame, only environmental areas such as sky, water surface, ground, walls, plants, or background can be extended.

The lower half extracts and reconstructs the "narrative core" of the photo: it can be a single primary subject, or a group of related elements that together embody the photo's identity, scale, action, o story relationship. Maintain its realistic, recognizable appearance, proportion, internal structure, texture, and relative position. Do not remove important related elements, and do not directly us rectangular photo cutouts. The reconstructed subject typically occupies 55%-80% of the width of the lower area. It should naturally extend based on the photo's primary direction and retain plausible ground, water lines, shadows, or softly dissipated edges to integrate into the background, avoiding a sticker-like or floating appearance.

Incorporate a narrow, low-saturation geometric color field behind or through the center of the subject, serving as a "critical window" between reality and editorial abstraction. The color of the window must be extracted from the original photo, and its orientation (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal) chosen based on the overall narrative direction.

The subject must actively pass through the window: part of it is within the color field, and part enters the open negative space, naturally crossing the window's boundary to create occlusion, penetration, and spatial depth. The window is not a frame or a card; it must not fully enclose the subject. Only one primary window is allowed; multiple color blocks, thick borders, rounded corners, strong gradients, and drop shadows are prohibited.

Use a white, cool white, very light gray, or near-white background for the lower half, coordinated with the photo. Employ a restrained asymmetrical composition and abundant negative space to establish a three-tier hierarchy:

Reconstructed subject or narrative composition

Low-saturation geometric window

Create a premium vintage Indian postage-stamp travel poster for [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT].

TEXT-TO-IMAGE ONLY — generate the entire artwork creatively from [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT] alone. No reference image required.

CORE CONCEPT
Transform the destination into a collectible vintage postage stamp, presenting its most iconic architecture, culture, landscape, and local character as a finely engraved travel illustration.

STAMP DESIGN
Create ONE centered postage stamp with authentic perforated edges and a subtle cream paper texture. Automatically select the most recognizable landmark or combination of visual elements that represents the destination.

Use detailed engraved linework, delicate crosshatching, vintage print texture, and slightly imperfect ink registration for an authentic old-world postal aesthetic.

INDIAN IDENTITY
Give the stamp a refined Indian postal character with:
- “भारत INDIA” as the header
- ₹100 denomination
- destination name in elegant Latin lettering
- the destination name again in its appropriate regional script

Adapt the regional script and cultural details accurately to the chosen location.

COLOR & COMPOSITION
Use a restrained destination-inspired palette with 3–5 complementary vintage colors. Keep the cream paper visible around the artwork and maintain strong visual hierarchy.

Include only meaningful local details — architecture, landscape, traditional motifs, vegetation, transportation, or cultural elements that genuinely belong to the destination.

STYLE
Vintage Indian postage stamp × engraved illustration × heritage printmaking × collectible travel ephemera.

The result should feel authentic, minimal, timeless, sophisticated, and museum-worthy rather than like a modern digital poster.

Avoid photorealism, glossy rendering, excessive colors, generic landmarks, invented cultural details, clutter, modern graphic effects, multiple separate stamps, logos, watermarks, and excessive text.

FORMAT
One stamp per image, vertical composition, perforated border, cream paper texture, highly detailed engraving, elegant typography, premium collectible finish.

使用细腻的雕版线条、精细的交叉影线、复古印刷质感,并略微保留套印不准的痕迹,以呈现真实的老派邮政美学。

赋予邮票精致的印度邮政气质,包含:
- 顶部标题 “भारत INDIA”

- 优雅的拉丁字母书写的目的地名称

复古印度邮票 × 雕版插画 × 传统版画工艺 × 可收藏旅行雅玩。

成品应呈现真实、极简、永恒、精致、可入藏的质感,而非现代数字海报。

避免照片级写实、光泽化渲染、过多色彩、泛化地标、虚构的文化细节、杂乱构图、现代图形特效、多枚独立邮票、标志、水印及过多文字。

格式
每张图像一枚邮票,纵向构图,带齿孔边框,米色纸张质感,高度精细的雕版细节,优雅的字体排印,顶级收藏级成品。

Create a stunning premium architectural travel poster inspired by vintage architectural illustration, featuring [LANDMARK / CITY] as the hero subject.

Show the landmark in an elegant three-quarter perspective, with extremely detailed hand-drawn architectural linework, intricate windows, balconies, columns, textures and ornamental details. Keep the sophisticated editorial composition of a collectible architecture magazine, but transform the artwork into a rich, bright, highly colorful illustration.

Use a beautiful palette of coral red, vibrant turquoise, cobalt blue, sunny yellow, emerald green, warm orange, pink, lavender and golden accents, with natural color variation rather than flat digital blocks. Add colorful trees, flowers, pedestrians, bicycles, vintage cars, street signs and subtle city-life details around the architecture.

Behind the landmark, include a delicate illustrated city map in pale pastel lines, architectural measurement marks, tiny street names and faint blueprint details. Add a small architectural detail sketch on one side, as if taken from an old design archive.

At the top, use refined typography:
[CITY NAME]
[LANDMARK NAME]
small location coordinates beneath.

At the bottom, include elegant archival-style information such as EST. [YEAR] · ARCHITECTURAL STYLE · CITY · COUNTRY.

The overall image should feel like a luxury collectible travel poster, combining colored-pencil texture, watercolor washes, fine ink drawing, subtle wax-crayon grain and vintage print imperfections. Bright sunlight, glowing colors, crisp details, warm paper texture, sophisticated composition, beautiful depth, highly detailed yet artistic.

Avoid: dull muted colors, photorealistic photography, generic cartoon style, excessive text, neon cyberpunk aesthetics, flat vector graphics.

Mood: joyful, colorful, cultured, nostalgic, sophisticated, artistic, instantly eye-catching, Pinterest-worthy and Instagram-viral.

创作一幅惊艳的高端建筑旅行海报，灵感源自复古建筑插画，以 [LANDMARK / CITY]（地标 / 城市）作为主角。

以优雅的四分之三视角呈现地标，配以极其精细的手绘建筑线条、繁复的窗户、阳台、立柱、质感与装饰细节。保持可收藏建筑杂志的精致编辑构图，但将画面转化为色彩丰富、明亮、极具表现力的插画。

使用由珊瑚红、鲜艳的绿松石色、钴蓝、阳光黄、翡翠绿、暖橙、粉红、薰衣草紫与金色点缀构成的美丽配色，通过自然的色彩过渡而非扁平的数字色块来表现。在建筑周围加入彩色的树木、花朵、行人、自行车、老式汽车、路标以及微妙的城市生活细节。

在地标后方，加入一幅用淡雅粉彩线条绘制的精致城市地图，包含建筑测量标注、极小号的街名以及隐约的蓝图细节。在一侧添加一幅小型建筑细部草图，仿佛取自旧日的设计档案。

在顶部，使用精致的字体排版：
[CITY NAME]（城市名称）
[LANDMARK NAME]（地标名称）
下方附上小号的位置坐标。

在底部，加入优雅的档案式信息，例如 EST. [YEAR] · ARCHITECTURAL STYLE · CITY · COUNTRY（始建年份 · 建筑风格 · 城市 · 国家）。

最终图像应呈现奢华可收藏旅行海报的质感，结合彩铅纹理、水彩晕染、细腻钢笔线条、柔和的蜡笔颗粒感与复古印刷瑕疵。阳光明媚、色彩鲜明、细节清晰、纸张质感温暖、构图精致、层次优美，既高度精细又充满艺术性。

避免：暗淡低沉的色彩，锐利的超写实摄影风格，泛化的卡通风格，过多文字，霓虹赛博朋克美学，扁平的矢量图形。

氛围：愉悦、缤纷、富有文化气息、怀旧、精致、艺术感、一眼吸睛、值得收藏并可在 Pinterest 与 Instagram 上疯传。

若想效果更加惊艳：让建筑主体保持较为写实与精细的刻画，同时让树木、天空、花朵、汽车与街头小元素迸发鲜艳的色彩。这种对比将使地标更加突出，同时不失优雅的建筑海报气质。

Do NOT regenerate the photograph.

Do NOT change its colors, lighting, composition, subject, mountains, rider, horse, landscape or perspective.

TOP SECTION — ORIGINAL PHOTO
Place the uploaded photograph across the upper approximately 46–48% of the poster.

The photograph must remain completely photorealistic and visually unchanged.

BOTTOM SECTION — ILLUSTRATED VERSION
Immediately below the photograph, create a warm ivory handmade-paper background.

In the lower section, create ONE SMALL centered watercolor illustration derived directly from the SAME photograph.

The illustration must show only the essential visual elements from the photo:

• the rider
• the horse/rider subject
• the important secondary horse if visible
• the rider's clothing and hat
• a very simplified mountain silhouette
• a faint distant tree line
• a few loose golden grass strokes

The bottom artwork must look like a delicate hand-painted travel-book illustration.

IMPORTANT:
Do NOT recreate the complete photograph in watercolor.

Remove most photographic information.

No detailed sky.
No detailed sunset.
No detailed houses.
No fences.
No tiny landscape objects.
No large foreground.
No realistic atmospheric effects.

The illustration should be approximately 35–45% of the width of the lower section and relatively small.

Leave LARGE empty ivory space around it.

The bottom illustration must NOT fill the lower half.

warm ivory paper
soft beige
muted gray
light brown
subtle golden ochre
delicate watercolor washes
fine ink outlines
slightly faded vintage print character

[STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE]

Cinematic cutscene of a hand-painted 2D point-and-click adventure game from the nineties, remade today. Fluid full-frame-rate cut-out animation of stick-figure characters over gouache painted backgrounds, flat side-on staging, locked game camera with a gentle parallax drift. Dry deadpan comedy with snappy timing. Seven shots joined by hard cuts.

[IMAGE REFERENCES]

Lewis [sheet_1], Mrs. Abernathy [sheet_2] and the fat orange tabby cat stay identical in every shot.

The stick figures have mouthless black faces: they talk with head nods, eye shapes and hand gestures. The cat talks with its mouth.

[AUDIO]

Language: American English.

Lewis: tired, dry, flat baritone.
Mrs. Abernathy: warm, sweet elderly voice.
Cat: very deep, gravelly bass.

Ambience of birds, light breeze and rustling leaves.
No background music.
No subtitles.

[TIMELINE]

0-4s: [Wide Shot] [scene_1]

Lewis taps his pencil on the notepad, lets out a sigh and says, flat:

{A cat got lost. A cat got found. Front page stuff.}

The huge cat sags heavier in her arms while she beams.

4-9s: [Close-Up] Hard cut to [scene_2]

She squeezes the cat, eyes glossy:

{He was gone for eleven whole minutes.}

The cat slowly turns its head to the viewer and says:

{Ask me about them, Lewis.}

9-13s: [Medium Shot] Hard cut to [scene_3]

Lewis stands frozen, eyes wide; the pencil hits the sidewalk <pencil clatter> and rolls.

He says:

{Ma'am... did your cat just talk?}

She answers with a calm little nod:

{He only talks to the press.}

13-18s: [Full Shot, low angle] Hard cut to [scene_4]

The cat rises, weightless, turning slowly, up past the maple crown into the lilac sky while leaves drift upward.

She waves it goodbye:

{He does that.}

Lewis watches it go, eyes half-lidded:

{I should've gone to law school.}

18-22s: [Wide Shot] Hard cut to [scene_5]

Purple clouds swirl, the colossal cat leans in over the rooftops, tiny Lewis's hair blows back.

Its mouth opens and the voice booms with a long echo:

{Wake up, Lewis.}

22-26s: [Medium Shot] Hard cut to [scene_6]

Sudden quiet, <alarm clock ticking>.

One still beat, then Lewis bolts upright in bed, eyes snapping wide open, the quilt sliding off his chest.

He stares ahead and mutters:

{...Eleven minutes.}

26-30s: [Wide Shot] Hard cut to [ingame_scene]

Lewis walks in from the left at an even pace and stops in front of the standing mirror, in profile facing right, his reflection appearing in the glass.

The red radio murmurs, tinny:

{...and in local news, a cat...}

He holds perfectly still for the final second.

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]

Hand-painted gouache backgrounds with paper grain, clean ink outlines, smooth fluid 2D animation, stable characters and wardrobe in every shot, coherent motion, crisp hard cuts, the painted backgrounds stay fixed inside each shot.

[STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE]

Dry deadpan comedy with snappy timing. Seven shots joined by hard cuts.

[IMAGE REFERENCES]

Lewis [sheet_1], Mrs. Abernathy [sheet_2] and the fat orange tabby cat stay identical in every shot.

The stick figures have mouthless black faces: they talk with head nods, eye shapes and hand gestures. The cat talks with its mouth.

[AUDIO]

Language: American English.

Lewis: tired, dry, flat baritone.
Mrs. Abernathy: warm, sweet elderly voice.
Cat: very deep, gravelly bass.

Ambience of birds, light breeze and rustling leaves.
No background music.
No subtitles.

[TIMELINE]

0-4s: [Wide Shot] [scene_1]

Lewis taps his pencil on the notepad, lets out a sigh and says, flat:

{A cat got lost. A cat got found. Front page stuff.}

The huge cat sags heavier in her arms while she beams.

4-9s: [Close-Up] Hard cut to [scene_2]

She squeezes the cat, eyes glossy:

{He was gone for eleven whole minutes.}

The cat slowly turns its head to the viewer and says:

{Ask me about them, Lewis.}

9-13s: [Medium Shot] Hard cut to [scene_3]

Lewis stands frozen, eyes wide; the pencil hits the sidewalk <pencil clatter> and rolls.

He says:

{Ma'am... did your cat just talk?}

She answers with a calm little nod:

{He only talks to the press.}

13-18s: [Full Shot, low angle] Hard cut to [scene_4]

The cat rises, weightless, turning slowly, up past the maple crown into the lilac sky while leaves drift upward.

She waves it goodbye:

{He does that.}

Lewis watches it go, eyes half-lidded:

{I should've gone to law school.}

18-22s: [Wide Shot] Hard cut to [scene_5]

Purple clouds swirl, the colossal cat leans in over the rooftops, tiny Lewis's hair blows back.

Its mouth opens and the voice booms with a long echo:

{Wake up, Lewis.}

22-26s: [Medium Shot] Hard cut to [scene_6]

Sudden quiet, <alarm clock ticking>.

One still beat, then Lewis bolts upright in bed, eyes snapping wide open, the quilt sliding off his chest.

He stares ahead and mutters:

{...Eleven minutes.}

26-30s: [Wide Shot] Hard cut to [ingame_scene]

Lewis walks in from the left at an even pace and stops in front of the standing mirror, in profile facing right, his reflection appearing in the glass.

The red radio murmurs, tinny:

{...and in local news, a cat...}

He holds perfectly still for the final second.

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]

Hand-painted gouache backgrounds with paper grain, clean ink outlines, smooth fluid 2D animation, stable characters and wardrobe in every shot, coherent motion, crisp hard cuts, the painted backgrounds stay fixed inside each shot.

Create a photorealistic cinematography reference poster containing exactly 12 panels in two equal columns and six rows. Each panel must demonstrate a distinct camera shot through an actual change in camera position or framing.

Main subject: A young adult man with short styled dark-brown hair, light stubble and a slim build. He wears a textured taupe-brown coat with dark buttons over a plain white crew-neck shirt, slim black trousers and white sneakers. Preserve his facial identity, hairstyle, clothing and proportions across every panel where he appears.

Location: A dim filmmaking studio with dark wooden furniture, muted grey walls, black ceiling beams, cream acoustic panels, a worktable, editing monitors, lighting stands, shelving and a leafy plant. Maintain consistent room details across viewpoints.

PANEL ORDER — LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM

Row 1
WIDE: Eye-level environmental shot. The man stands near the center, relatively small within the frame, surrounded by the studio and furniture.
LOW: Dramatic low-angle shot looking upward from below his waist. His upper body rises against the ceiling beams, with believable perspective.

Row 2
LONG: Full-length portrait showing his entire body from head to shoes, with a little space above and below. Studio equipment remains visible around him.
HIGH: Camera positioned above the man, looking steeply downward as he looks up. Show the floor and nearby table to establish the elevated viewpoint.

Row 3
MEDIUM: Eye-level waist-up portrait. His hands rest loosely together, expression relaxed, background softly blurred.
DUTCH: Medium-long shot with the camera rolled approximately 25 degrees. The room’s vertical lines visibly tilt while the man stands naturally upright within the room.

Row 4
COWBOY: Frame the man from mid-thigh to just above his head. He looks down with both hands in his coat pockets.
OVER THE SHOULDER: Look past the softly blurred head and shoulder of the brown-coated man in the right foreground toward a second young adult man wearing a black T-shirt and backward black cap. Keep the second man’s face sharp.

Row 5
TIGHT, with smaller subtitle CLOSE UP: Close portrait of the main subject’s face, from the top of his hair to just below his chin. Capture natural skin texture and a subtle, thoughtful expression.
POV, with smaller subtitle POINT OF VIEW: First-person view from the main subject’s seated position, looking down at his hands using a laptop on a dark table. Taupe coat cuffs visible. The screen shows a plausible grid of small video thumbnails.

Row 6
DETAIL, with smaller subtitle EXTREME CLOSE UP: Extreme close-up of the main subject’s eye, eyebrow and bridge of the nose. Render realistic eyelashes, pores and a small natural catchlight.
CUTAWAY: An insert shot of a professional cinema camera on a support rig in the same studio, with shelving and a small potted plant behind it. No person visible.

PHOTOGRAPHIC TREATMENT

Real live-action film-still appearance. Soft directional lighting, restrained warm skin tones, charcoal shadows, muted brown and grey colors, subtle grain and natural contrast. Use deeper focus for environmental views and shallow depth of field for portraits and detail shots. Preserve realistic anatomy, optical perspective and consistent facial features.

LAYOUT & TYPOGRAPHY

Tall 3:5 poster composition, edge-to-edge imagery, uniform panel dimensions, clean aligned divisions and no large gutters. Place each shot label near the lower-left corner of its panel in white uppercase sans-serif lettering with generous letter spacing. Use smaller, clearly readable subtitles beneath TIGHT, POV and DETAIL. Split OVER THE SHOULDER into two lines to fit neatly. Keep all text inside its own panel and away from important facial details.

Render only the specified shot labels. No additional headline, explanatory paragraphs, logos or watermarks.

Avoid: Missing or repeated panels, incorrect shot labels, inconsistent faces or outfits, identical framing across panels, malformed hands, distorted equipment, artificial skin, illustration, excessive HDR and unreadable typography.

创建一张照片级真实感的电影摄影参考海报，包含恰好 12 个面板，分为两列等宽、六行排列。每一个面板都必须通过实际改变机位或取景来展现一种不同的镜头。

主体人物：一名年轻成年男性，留着打理过的深棕色短发、淡淡的胡茬、身材偏瘦。他身穿质感明显的灰褐色（灰褐色）大衣，大衣配有深色纽扣，内搭纯白色圆领衬衫，下身穿修身黑色长裤和白色运动鞋。在他出现的每一个面板中，都要保持其面部特征、发型、服饰和身材比例一致。

场景：一间灯光昏暗的电影制作工作室，室内有深色木质家具、柔和的灰色墙壁、黑色天花横梁、米色声学板、一张工作台、剪辑监视器、灯具支架、置物架以及一株绿叶植物。不同视角下要保持房间细节一致。

面板顺序——从左到右、从上到下

第一行
WIDE（远景）：平视的环境镜头。男子站在画面中央偏后的位置，在画面中身形相对较小，被工作室和家具环绕。
LOW（低角度）：从他腰部以下向上仰拍的戏剧性低角度镜头。他的上半身映衬着天花横梁，呈现出可信的透视关系。

第二行
LONG（全景）：全身肖像，显示他从头到鞋的完整身体，上下留有少量空间。他周围依然可见工作室设备。
HIGH（俯角）：相机位于男子上方，在他向上看的时候大幅俯拍。需展示地板和附近的桌子，以确立升高的视角。

第三行
MEDIUM（中景）：平视的腰部以上肖像。他的双手自然地搭在一起，神情放松，背景柔和虚化。
DUTCH（荷兰角）：中等偏长的镜头，相机横滚约 25 度。房间的垂直线明显倾斜，但男子在房间中自然直立。

第四行
COWBOY（牛仔景）：从男子大腿中部到头顶略上一点进行构图。他低着头，双手插在大衣口袋里。
OVER THE SHOULDER（过肩镜头）：越过右前景中穿着棕色大衣、头部和肩部柔和虚化的男子，望向第二位戴黑色 T 恤、反戴黑色棒球帽的年轻成年男性。需保持第二位男子的面部清晰。

第五行
TIGHT（紧凑景），下排附较小副标题 CLOSE UP（特写）：主体的近距离肖像，从头顶发际到下巴略下方。需捕捉自然的皮肤质感和微妙、若有所思的表情。
POV（主观视角），下排附较小副标题 POINT OF VIEW（第一人称视角）：从其坐姿出发向下看，看到他在一张深色桌子上使用笔记本电脑的双手。可见灰褐色大衣袖口。屏幕上显示一个合理的小视频缩略图网格。

第六行
DETAIL（细节景），下排附较小副标题 EXTREME CLOSE UP（大特写）：主体眼睛、眉毛和鼻梁的大特写。需呈现真实的睫毛、毛孔和一处自然的微小高光。
CUTAWAY（插播镜头 / 空镜）：在同一工作室中，一台架设在支撑装置上的专业电影摄影机的插入镜头，其后方为置物架和一盆小型盆栽。画面中不出现人物。

摄影处理

呈现真实实拍剧照的外观。柔和的方向性光线、克制的暖色肤色调、木炭般的阴影、柔和的棕色与灰色、轻微的颗粒感和自然的对比度。环境视角使用较深的景深，人像和细节镜头使用浅景深。保持真实的解剖结构、光学透视和一致的面部特征。

布局与排版

高长比 3:5 的海报构图，画面延伸到边缘，面板尺寸统一，分割线整齐对齐，不留大间隔。每个镜头的标签置于其面板左下角附近，使用白色大写无衬线字体，字距宽松。TIGHT、POV 和 DETAIL 下方使用更小、清晰可读的副标题。OVER THE SHOULDER 拆为两行以整齐排布。所有文字需留在所属面板内，并避开重要的面部细节。

仅渲染指定的镜头标签。不要附加主标题、说明性段落、标志或水印。

需避免：缺失或重复的面板、错误的镜头标签、面部或服饰不一致、各面板取景相同、手部畸形、设备变形、人工变异般的皮肤、插画风格、过度的 HDR 以及无法辨认的排版。

SUBJECT:
A striking adult female fashion model photographed as a real human being. Elegant elongated proportions, sophisticated editorial presence, unusual but believable beauty, natural facial anatomy, realistic skin texture, visible pores, subtle imperfections, individual hair strands and authentic human detail. Her expression is calm, slightly strange, mysterious and fashion-forward rather than smiling.

CONCEPT:
Build the entire photograph around [THEME].

Transform the theme into a complete couture universe rather than simply placing decorative objects around the model. The clothing, hairstyle, makeup, footwear, pose, oversized prop, furniture and studio environment should all share the same visual language.

Create one unforgettable oversized practical centerpiece related to [THEME], approximately comparable in scale to the model. It must appear physically constructed for a real fashion shoot — fabric, painted wood, papier-mâché, rope, satin, leather, plaster or other believable handcrafted materials — with seams, stitching, folds, slight wear and tactile surface detail.

FASHION:
Design an original couture outfit with exaggerated sculptural proportions and immaculate tailoring. Use architectural shoulders, unusual silhouettes, corsetry, puffed or balloon forms, oversized bows, gathered fabric, dramatic hosiery and custom sculptural footwear where appropriate.

The garment must feel like a one-off creation made by an experimental couture atelier, not cosplay, Halloween clothing or a generic fantasy costume.

The styling should be eccentric and surreal but still sophisticated enough for a major high-fashion editorial.

HAIR & MAKEUP:
Create highly art-directed editorial hair that complements the concept: geometric shapes, sculptural forms, short graphic cuts, exaggerated bows or controlled theatrical styling.

Use conceptual runway makeup with carefully placed graphic details around the eyes and cheeks while retaining realistic skin. Makeup should feel professionally applied to a real model, never painted CGI skin.

COMPOSITION:
Full-body vertical fashion portrait.
The entire outfit and footwear are visible.
Model positioned in an unusual editorial pose — seated, leaning, balancing, extending one leg, interacting naturally with the oversized prop or suspended installation.

Use intentional negative space and strong graphic geometry.

The giant prop should create a bold silhouette around or behind the model without hiding her face.

SET DESIGN:
Photograph everything inside a real constructed studio set.

Use a seamless or lightly textured hand-painted backdrop in a sophisticated muted color palette. Add only a few carefully selected practical objects that reinforce the theme.

The environment should feel like an expensive physical fashion set built by set designers, not a digitally generated fantasy world.

Allow subtle imperfections: slightly worn painted wood, fabric wrinkles, visible stitching, handmade edges, aged surfaces and realistic contact shadows.

COLOR:
Use an art-directed limited palette of approximately 3–4 colors.

Combine muted vintage tones with one stronger accent color. Avoid random rainbow colors, oversaturation and modern neon aesthetics.

LIGHTING:
Large diffused studio key light from approximately 45 degrees, soft directional fill, subtle falloff toward the background and delicate separation around the model.

Realistic shadows underneath shoes, furniture and props.
No excessive rim lighting.
No glowing fantasy illumination.

The lighting should resemble an expensive medium-format editorial photographed inside a physical studio.

CAMERA:
Full-frame / medium-format fashion photography aesthetic,
approximately 50–85mm perspective,
camera around waist-to-chest height,
minimal perspective distortion,
sharp focus on model and principal prop,
fine textile and skin detail,
subtle optical softness,
natural depth,
high dynamic range.

IMAGE CHARACTER:
Surreal.
Whimsical.
Slightly uncanny.
Theatrical.
Retro-European fashion editorial.
Handcrafted.
Playful but sophisticated.
Museum-worthy couture photography.

The viewer should initially wonder whether this was an elaborate real-world fashion set rather than an AI-generated image.

REALISM PRIORITY:
100% photographic appearance.
Real adult human anatomy.
Real skin.
Natural hands and fingers.
Correct limbs.
Physically plausible interaction between body, clothing, furniture and props.
Authentic fabric tension and gravity.
Realistic stitching and material thickness.
Real contact shadows.
Believable weight and scale.

Preserve tiny imperfections that make physical photography convincing.

Avoid glossy CGI rendering, plastic skin, doll-like facial texture, generic AI beauty, excessive facial symmetry, fake depth of field, floating objects, malformed hands, extra fingers, duplicated limbs, impossible joints, melted fabrics, random accessories, meaningless decorations, cheap costume appearance, excessive background clutter, text, logos or watermark.

An original surreal couture campaign image that feels photographed for an experimental international fashion magazine — strange enough to stop scrolling immediately, yet polished, tactile and believable enough to look like an expensive real-world editorial production.

natural depth,
high dynamic range.

设计一款高级涂层冰棒：浅香槟—象牙色外壳，嵌入夏威夷果碎与奶油糖脆片。前上缘咬去一口，露出致密丝滑的香草色冰淇淋，中央流淌一条熔融的琥珀色奶油糖丝带。外壳应感觉酥脆、略厚、奢华而不规则，咬口边缘有细腻的断裂纹路，表面有内嵌的坚果浮雕。木棒为洁净的浅木色，精炼，并低调烙有虚构标记 AURELIA CRISP。主视觉产品必须感觉可食、有触感、昂贵，且工艺无可挑剔。

构建一幅抽象高级甜品摄影棚场域：温润的象牙白到奶油糖色的渐变背景，明亮通透而不平板。一道如丝绸般的牛奶奶油与焦糖化乳汁飞溅环在冰棒后方弯曲，营造围合与动感的同时保持主次层次。夏威夷果仁、破碎的半粒坚果、酥脆焦糖薄片与细密奶油水珠分布在主物体周围的纵深层次中。所有元素保持洁净、有意、留白。无桌面、无手部、无杂乱、无多余道具。

光线为明亮奢华的影棚光：柔和正面主光、细腻的左上辉光，以及沿外壳质感、咬口内芯与糖浆核心的精致高光塑形。配色层级：60% 象牙奶油、浅香草与夏威夷果米色；30% 香槟焦糖、奶油糖琥珀与柔金；10% 烘焙坚果棕、暖木色与细微阴影点缀。保持高亮度、奶油般的对比与精确的边缘分离。无浑浊米色、无死白过曝、无脏阴影。情绪基调为丝滑、酥脆、明亮、可收藏、令人沉醉。

材质必须极度照片写实：酥脆的坚果拓扑、微妙的光泽变化、细小的涂层涟漪与可信的外壳厚度；咬口内芯呈现细腻奶油般的冰晶柔软感，但不可显得僵冻如塑料；一条黏稠光亮的奶油糖丝带；夏威夷果粒为干燥哑光的内里、略带缎光的外表，以及真实的色彩变化；一道厚润丝滑的奶油飞溅，物理流动连贯一致。右下方包装应为小巧而锐利的高级产品图，遵循一致的配色逻辑与精确的标签印刷。

将高级英文排版融入海报结构。左上放置雕刻感的标题字组，内容为 “AURELIA CRISP / MACADAMIA BUTTERSCOTCH”，使用优雅高定时装风格的衬线体或高对比编辑感字体系统，字距宽松。其下加入克制的短句 “crisp shell, molten heart.” 右下靠近次要产品图的位置，放置一枚低调的圆形香槟金印章，内含简短的微文案，例如 “limited release”。排版必须轻盈、有艺术指导感、嵌入动势之中，绝不显沉重或突兀。
